description: This file defines the Zend_Locale_Data class, which provides methods for loading, caching, and retrieving locale-specific data from XML files in the Zend Framework. It includes functions for accessing various locale components such as language, script, territory, date/time formats, currency data, timezone mappings, and more.

classes.name: Zend_Locale_Data
classes.description: A class providing static methods to access locale data from XML files, with caching support.

methods.name: _readFile
methods.description: Reads values from the loaded XML locale data based on XPath, attribute, and value parameters.

methods.name: _findRoute
methods.description: Resolves locale aliasing and routing to other locale files or paths.

methods.name: _getFile
methods.description: Loads locale data from XML files, following locale fallback hierarchy.

methods.name: _calendarDetail
methods.description: Determines calendar detail keys based on locale and list.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of locale-specific data (e.g., languages, scripts, territories) for a given locale and path.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Retrieves a specific locale data value based on locale, path, and optional value.

methods.name: setCache
methods.description: Sets a cache object for storing locale data to improve performance.
